mostWorthwhile.text: Releasing dissolved volatiles as pressure fell was most worthwhile: it connected the physical process to outgassing and clarified that it does not create water’s hydrogen.

leastWorthwhile.text: The crust sequence became somewhat repetitive because the last few choices were the only available combinations, even though the results added useful detail.

surprise.text: The fractured crust provides routes for later water, giving the cracking a longer-term role beyond making a volcanic surface.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although some later combinations were prescribed by the menu rather than decisions I had to work out.

continue.text: Yes. I would like to see how rain interacts with the contrasting lava and solid crust, particularly through the fractures.
